# Deutsche Telekom Corporate Website
> Deutsche Telekom’s corporate website provides information about the Group, its strategy, governance, responsibility, compliance, and global operations.

The site focuses on corporate, investor-relevant, governance, and sustainability topics for one of the world’s leading integrated telecommunications companies.

## Company Overview
- [Company](https://www.telekom.com/en/company): Main corporate overview for Deutsche Telekom’s business, structure, and key topics.
- [Company Profile](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/companyprofile/company-profile-625808): Summary of Deutsche Telekom’s identity, operations, and corporate profile.
- [Worldwide](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/worldwide): Overview of Deutsche Telekom’s international presence and global footprint.
- [Topic Specials](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/topic-specials): Curated corporate focus topics, campaigns, and thematic highlights.

## Strategy and Leadership
- [Strategy](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/strategy): Corporate strategy, priorities, and long-term direction of the Group.
- [Management and Corporate Governance](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/management-and-corporate-governance): Central hub for leadership structure and governance information.
- [Board of Management](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/management-and-corporate-governance/board-of-management): Profiles and responsibilities of Deutsche Telekom’s Board of Management.
- [Supervisory Board](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/management-and-corporate-governance/supervisory-board): Composition and role of the Supervisory Board.
- [Management unplugged](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/management-unplugged): Leadership perspectives and management-related corporate content.

## Governance, Reports, and Remuneration
- [Management and Corporate Governance](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/management-and-corporate-governance): Governance framework, leadership bodies, and oversight structures.
- [Reports and Declarations](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/management-and-corporate-governance#1086370): Corporate governance reports, declarations, and related disclosures.
- [Remuneration](https://report.telekom.com/remuneration): Information on remuneration systems and compensation reporting.
- [Board of Management](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/management-and-corporate-governance/board-of-management): Executive leadership details relevant to governance and accountability.
- [Supervisory Board](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/management-and-corporate-governance/supervisory-board): Oversight body information and supervisory governance details.

## Responsibility, Privacy, and Security
- [Data Privacy and Security](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/data-privacy-and-security): Corporate information on privacy, data protection, and security topics.
- [Digital Responsibility](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/digital-responsibility): Deutsche Telekom’s approach to responsible digitalization and related commitments.
- [Topic Specials](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/topic-specials): Featured content covering responsibility and other strategic corporate themes.
- [Company](https://www.telekom.com/en/company): Broader corporate context for responsibility and trust-related initiatives.

## Compliance and Ethics
- [Compliance](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/compliance): Overview of compliance management and integrity-related corporate policies.
- [Code of Conduct](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/compliance/code-of-conduct): Principles and behavioral standards expected across the organization.
- [Whistleblowerportal - TellMe](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/compliance/whistleblowerportal): Reporting channel for whistleblowing and compliance-related concerns.
- [Management and Corporate Governance](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/management-and-corporate-governance): Governance context supporting compliance and oversight structures.

## People and Culture
- [Human Resources](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/human-resources): Information on workforce topics, people strategy, and HR-related initiatives.
- [Diversity](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/human-resources/diversity): Diversity and inclusion commitments, programs, and related corporate information.
- [Works Council](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/works-council): Information about employee representation and works council topics.
- [Sponsoring](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/sponsoring): Corporate sponsoring activities and supported initiatives.

## Global Presence and Corporate Topics
- [Worldwide](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/worldwide): International markets, operations, and regional corporate presence.
- [Company Profile](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/companyprofile/company-profile-625808): High-level corporate facts useful for understanding the Group globally.
- [Topic Specials](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/topic-specials): Thematic corporate stories and special-focus content.
- [Digital Responsibility](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/digital-responsibility): Group-wide perspective on responsible digital transformation.

## Key Corporate Resources
- [Company](https://www.telekom.com/en/company): Starting point for corporate information about Deutsche Telekom.
- [Strategy](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/strategy): Core strategic direction and business priorities.
- [Compliance](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/compliance): Main compliance and ethics resource.
- [Data Privacy and Security](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/data-privacy-and-security): Primary privacy and security information page.
- [Human Resources](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/human-resources): Central people and workforce information resource.
- [Management and Corporate Governance](https://www.telekom.com/en/company/management-and-corporate-governance): Main governance and leadership information hub.
